nakedSingle.title: Naked Single
nakedSingle.explain: {{cell}} has only one candidate left: {{digit}}. Every other digit already appears in its row, column or box.
nakedSingle.summary: A cell has only one possible digit left, because every other digit already appears in its row, column or box.

hiddenSingle.title: Hidden Single
hiddenSingle.explain_row: In row {{unit}}, the digit {{digit}} fits in only one cell: {{cell}}.
hiddenSingle.explain_col: In column {{unit}}, the digit {{digit}} fits in only one cell: {{cell}}.
hiddenSingle.explain_box: In box {{unit}}, the digit {{digit}} fits in only one cell: {{cell}}.
hiddenSingle.summary: In a row, column or box, a digit fits in only one cell, even if that cell has other candidates.

pointing.title: Pointing Pair / Triple
pointing.explain_row: In box {{box}}, {{digit}} can only be in row {{unit}}. So {{digit}} can be removed from the rest of row {{unit}}.
pointing.explain_col: In box {{box}}, {{digit}} can only be in column {{unit}}. So {{digit}} can be removed from the rest of column {{unit}}.
pointing.summary: Inside a box, a digit can only go in one row (or column). It can be removed from the rest of that line outside the box.

claiming.title: Box/Line Reduction
claiming.explain_row: In row {{unit}}, {{digit}} can only be in box {{box}}. So {{digit}} can be removed from the other cells of box {{box}}.
claiming.explain_col: In column {{unit}}, {{digit}} can only be in box {{box}}. So {{digit}} can be removed from the other cells of box {{box}}.
claiming.summary: Inside a row (or column), a digit can only go in one box. It can be removed from the other cells of that box.

nakedPair.title: Naked Pair
nakedPair.explain_row: {{cells}} can only contain {{digits}}. Those digits can be removed from the other cells of row {{unit}}.
nakedPair.explain_col: {{cells}} can only contain {{digits}}. Those digits can be removed from the other cells of column {{unit}}.
nakedPair.explain_box: {{cells}} can only contain {{digits}}. Those digits can be removed from the other cells of box {{unit}}.
nakedPair.summary: Two cells in a unit share the same two candidates. Those two digits must go there, so they can be removed from the rest of the unit.

hiddenPair.title: Hidden Pair
hiddenPair.explain_row: In row {{unit}}, {{digits}} can only go in {{cells}}. All other candidates can be removed from those cells.
hiddenPair.explain_col: In column {{unit}}, {{digits}} can only go in {{cells}}. All other candidates can be removed from those cells.
hiddenPair.explain_box: In box {{unit}}, {{digits}} can only go in {{cells}}. All other candidates can be removed from those cells.
hiddenPair.summary: Two digits can only go in the same two cells of a unit. Those cells can lose all their other candidates.

nakedTriple.title: Naked Triple
nakedTriple.explain_row: {{cells}} can only contain {{digits}}. Those digits can be removed from the other cells of row {{unit}}.
nakedTriple.explain_col: {{cells}} can only contain {{digits}}. Those digits can be removed from the other cells of column {{unit}}.
nakedTriple.explain_box: {{cells}} can only contain {{digits}}. Those digits can be removed from the other cells of box {{unit}}.
nakedTriple.summary: Three cells in a unit use only three digits between them. Those digits can be removed from the rest of the unit.

hiddenTriple.title: Hidden Triple
hiddenTriple.explain_row: In row {{unit}}, {{digits}} can only go in {{cells}}. All other candidates can be removed from those cells.
hiddenTriple.explain_col: In column {{unit}}, {{digits}} can only go in {{cells}}. All other candidates can be removed from those cells.
hiddenTriple.explain_box: In box {{unit}}, {{digits}} can only go in {{cells}}. All other candidates can be removed from those cells.
hiddenTriple.summary: Three digits can only go in the same three cells of a unit. Those cells can lose all their other candidates.

xWing.title: X-Wing
xWing.explain_row: In rows {{lines}}, {{digit}} can only be in columns {{crossLines}}. So {{digit}} can be removed from the rest of those columns.
xWing.explain_col: In columns {{lines}}, {{digit}} can only be in rows {{crossLines}}. So {{digit}} can be removed from the rest of those rows.
xWing.summary: In two rows, a digit fits in only the same two columns. It must sit on two opposite corners, so it can be removed from the rest of those columns.

xyWing.title: XY-Wing
xyWing.explain: Whichever of its two digits {{pivot}} takes, one of the wings {{wings}} must be {{digit}}. So any cell that sees both wings cannot be {{digit}}.
xyWing.summary: A pivot cell {X,Y} sees two wings {X,Z} and {Y,Z}. One wing must be Z, so any cell seeing both wings cannot be Z.

mistake.title: Incorrect digit
mistake.explain: {{cell}} contains {{digit}}, which is not correct. Apply to erase it.

badNotes.title: Check your notes
badNotes.explain: The notes in {{cell}} leave out the correct digit. Apply to fix them.

none.title: No hint available
none.explain: None of the techniques in the hint list applies here. Apply to reveal one cell.

home.title: Sudoku Master: Free Online Sudoku That Works Offline
home.description: Play free Sudoku in your browser: 5 difficulty levels, a daily challenge and hints that explain the logic. Works offline, in English, French and Arabic.

daily.title: Daily Sudoku Challenge | Sudoku Master
daily.description: A new free Sudoku puzzle every day. Keep your streak going and earn a badge for every completed month.

stats.title: Your Statistics | Sudoku Master
stats.description: Games played, win rate and best times for each Sudoku difficulty.

howTo.title: How to Play Sudoku: Rules and Techniques | Sudoku Master
howTo.description: Learn the rules of Sudoku and the solving techniques behind every hint: singles, pairs, triples, X-Wing and XY-Wing.

leaderboard.title: Sudoku Leaderboard: Top Players | Sudoku Master
leaderboard.description: The best Sudoku Master players: all-time and weekly rankings, and the daily challenge leaderboard. Sign in to earn points.

easy.title: Easy Sudoku: Play Free Online | Sudoku Master
easy.heading: Easy Sudoku
easy.description: Free easy Sudoku puzzles, solvable with singles only. Perfect for beginners. Hints explain every step. Works offline.
easy.intro: Easy puzzles start with 36 or more numbers and can be solved with singles alone: find the one cell where a digit fits. Ideal for learning, or for a quick, relaxing game.

medium.title: Medium Sudoku: Play Free Online | Sudoku Master
medium.heading: Medium Sudoku
medium.description: Free medium Sudoku puzzles with 30 to 35 givens. Practise pointing pairs and box/line reduction, with hints that explain the logic.
medium.intro: Medium puzzles have 30 to 35 givens. Besides singles, you will need intersections: when a digit is confined to one row or column inside a box, it can be removed from the rest of that line, and the other way round.

hard.title: Hard Sudoku: Play Free Online | Sudoku Master
hard.heading: Hard Sudoku
hard.description: Free hard Sudoku puzzles with 28 to 31 givens. Master naked and hidden pairs and triples, with step-by-step hints.
hard.intro: Hard puzzles have 28 to 31 givens and call for subsets: naked and hidden pairs and triples that let you clear candidates from the cells around them.

expert.title: Expert Sudoku: Play Free Online | Sudoku Master
expert.heading: Expert Sudoku
expert.description: Free expert Sudoku puzzles that need X-Wing and XY-Wing. Every hint explains the pattern. Works offline.
expert.intro: Expert puzzles have 24 to 29 givens and cannot be finished without advanced patterns such as the X-Wing and the XY-Wing.

master.title: Master Sudoku: The Hardest Free Puzzles | Sudoku Master
master.heading: Master Sudoku
master.description: Our hardest free Sudoku puzzles: 25 givens or fewer, solvable by pure logic. Hints explain every advanced step.
master.intro: Master puzzles have 25 givens or fewer and combine every technique, X-Wing and XY-Wing included. Still solvable by logic alone: a real test for experienced players.

howTo.title: How to play Sudoku
howTo.intro: Sudoku is played on a 9×9 grid divided into nine 3×3 boxes. Some cells are already filled in. Your goal is to fill in every empty cell.

rules.row: Each row must contain the digits 1 to 9 exactly once.
rules.col: Each column must contain the digits 1 to 9 exactly once.
rules.box: Each 3×3 box must contain the digits 1 to 9 exactly once.
rules.unique: Every puzzle has exactly one solution, and it can always be found by logic, without guessing.

controls.place: Tap a cell, then a number, to place a digit.
controls.notes: Turn on Notes to write candidates in a cell.
controls.hint: Hint shows the next logical step and explains it. Press Apply to use it.
controls.mistakes: A wrong digit counts as a mistake. After 3 mistakes the game is over (you can turn this off in Settings).

howTo.techniquesIntro: These are the techniques the hint system uses, from easiest to hardest. Each difficulty level needs the ones before it.
